items.title_zh: 870万副之后，AI眼镜离下一个“iPhone 4时刻”还有多远？
items.title: After 8.7 million units, how far are AI glasses from their next "iPhone 4 moment"?
items.summary: Global AI glasses shipments reached 8.7 million units in 2025, up 322% year on year, and are heading towards more than 15 million in 2026 — but does that mean the industry has crossed the threshold of mass adoption? The answer is not simple: what actually works today is the display-free route of fashion frames plus camera plus open-ear audio plus an AI assistant, while light-display products remain constrained by weight, battery life, optics and cost.
items.summary_zh: 2025年全球AI眼镜出货量达到870万副，同比增长322%，并在2026年继续向1500万副以上迈进，但这是否意味着行业已经跨过大众普及的临界点？答案并不简单：当前真正跑通的是“时尚眼镜＋相机＋开放式耳机＋AI助手”的无显示路线，轻显示产品仍受重量、续航、光学和成本制约
